newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Telecom eyes Singapore market.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom eyes Singapore market.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was investigating opportunities to capitalise on the break up of Singapore's domestic telephone monopoly.
"We are looking at regional investment, and Singapore is one of those opportunities that we will look at carefully," said Pearl Tong, a spokeswoman for Hongkong Telecom.
The Singapore government said on Monday up to two new operators would be allowed to compete with Singapore Telecommunications Ltd on basic telecommunications services from April 1, 2000.
Foreign companies would be allowed to to take up to 49 percent of any joint venture project.
The South China Morning Post on Wednesday quoted a telecommunications analyst as saying an investment of up to HK$5 billion would be needed to finance a successful bid.
But Tong said it was too early to quantify the level of investment that might be needed if Hongkong Telecom decided to pursue opportunities in Singapore.
